Quick summary

Nordregio's maps collection provides over 200 spatial analyses covering demography, labour markets, migration, and regional development across Nordic, Arctic, and Baltic regions — a reference resource for evidence-based regional policy.

Key takeaways

  • Nordregio maintains a collection of 200+ maps covering Nordic, Arctic, and Baltic regional patterns
  • Key thematic areas: demography (201 maps), labour market (78), migration (60), regional development (29)
  • Recent maps cover topics including population aging, fertility trends, green patents, and municipal boundaries
  • Maps serve as spatial evidence for regional development policy and Nordic cooperation
  • The institution produces maps that reveal patterns and trends across multiple decades of regional change
